limitations: Deferred and not fixed in this card: concurrent `compare up` has no lock (record loss, duplicate ports); a shared entry already running from another comparison is reported as started and a down suggested after a failed up of a second comparison can stop it; the human status table has no pid/log/readiness columns; skipped rows carry no pids; `down --json` and `status --json` print variants:null for an empty record. The 1st and 2nd raw review reports are summarized in the card, not stored as files.
